# OrdLume Home Readiness Utility

OrdLume provides a free, registration-free household disaster-readiness utility in Japanese.

Primary URL: https://ordlume.vercel.app/

Core purpose:
- Check 10 household readiness categories in about 2 minutes.
- Show a simple readiness score.
- Identify missing basics.
- Turn gaps into three next actions: today, this week, this month.
- Avoid fear pressure and unnecessary purchasing.

Main sections:
- / — interactive readiness check
- /guides/ — disaster-readiness guides
- /water/ — emergency water guide
- /food/ — emergency food guide
- /blackout/ — blackout preparation
- /battery/ — backup power guide
- /toilet/ — sanitation and toilet preparation
- /solo/ — preparedness for people living alone
- /family/ — family preparedness
- /pet/ — preparedness with pets
- /gear.html — gap-based preparedness guide
- /plan.html — printable household readiness plan
- /methodology.html — scoring and methodology
- /sources.html — public sources and official references
- /press.html — media information
- /privacy.html — privacy information

Important notes:
- This is not a government service.
- Medical, evacuation and public-support decisions should rely on current official information.
- Support/donations are optional and do not change utility functionality.
